svg.title: The Durable Agent Network
svg.desc: Three clients, a web UI, dpi-tui and curl, connect to four devices that each run a durable pi agent; every client disconnects, and every device keeps writing its run's checkpoints to its own SQLite until the run is done.
svg.text: Close every client. The work continues.
No client connected. Every run keeps checkpointing to its device's SQLite.
